badges.tokensAcross: Use Usage Units across courses and AI

hero.title: One balance for courses and AI strategies.
hero.subtitle: Load a Usage Balance once and use it across Cur Nova: structured PDF courses, custom courses and AI-generated strategies. Usage Units are bought by card in EUR.

bullets.oneBalance: One balance for Forex, Crypto and Binary content.
bullets.payWithTokens: Buy Usage Units by card in EUR, then spend them on any product.
bullets.topUpAnytime: Top up any time – Usage Units do not expire.

exampleRate.title: Usage Unit rate
exampleRate.subtitle: Fixed rate
exampleRate.description: Usage Units are always priced at a fixed rate of 100 Usage Units = €1.14. You see the exact price before you pay.
exampleRate.example: <tokens>{tokens}</tokens> = <price>{price}</price>. You see the exact price, currency and number of Usage Units before you pay.

tokenPacks.title: Usage Unit Packages.
tokenPacks.subtitle: Start small or commit for longer – each pack loads Usage Units into your Cur Nova balance for use across courses and AI.
tokenPacks.note: All prices are final and shown in {currency}.
tokenPacks.info: You receive exactly the number of Usage Units shown on each package.

customTopUp.title: Custom top-up
customTopUp.subtitle: Set any amount in EUR. We convert it to Usage Units at the fixed rate of 100 Usage Units = €1.14.
customTopUp.minAmount: Minimum 0.01 in any supported currency. No formal maximum – larger top-ups are simply converted into more Usage Units.
customTopUp.youGet: You pay {price} {currency} and receive {units} Usage Units.

directPayment.title: Buying a single course
directPayment.subtitle: No balance yet? At checkout you can buy, by card, exactly the Usage Units a course costs and then complete the purchase with those Units.

bullets.currencies: Card payments are charged in EUR by Visa or Mastercard.
bullets.noTokens: A card payment adds Usage Units to your Usage Balance. The course itself is then bought with Usage Units.
bullets.convertLater: Any Usage Units left over stay in your Usage Balance for later purchases.

howTokensWork.title: How Usage Units work inside Cur Nova.
howTokensWork.subtitle: A simple balance that powers both structured courses and AI-based tools.

step1.title: Add Usage Units
step1.description: Buy a pack or set a custom top-up using your preferred currency.

step2.title: Use Usage Units on content
step2.description: Spend Usage Units on ready-made courses, custom PDFs and AI strategies.

step3.title: Track in your dashboard
step3.description: See balance, usage and history – including which products used how many Usage Units.

step4.title: Top up when needed
step4.description: Usage Units do not expire, so you can top up at your own pace when the balance gets low.

riskNotice.title: Important risk and Usage Unit notice.
riskNotice.paragraph1: Trading Forex, Crypto and Binary options is highly speculative and can lead to substantial or total loss of capital. Usage Units, courses and AI outputs on Cur Nova are for educational purposes only. They do not contain financial advice or trading signals.
riskNotice.paragraph2: Usage Units themselves are a way to access digital educational content inside Cur Nova. They are not a separate financial product or investment. Usage Unit pricing, refund rules and any region-specific limitations are set out in our Terms & Conditions, Refund Policy and Risk & Disclaimer.
